meta.triageRationale: bugfix/small routed issue -> build; one module (vscode-plugin/src/chat/chat-panel.ts, possibly the session stores' list()).

body.focus: Implement approved ISSUE-0d3939248a956860: (a) the chat history menu opens showing the most recent chats first whatever row is selected (incl. an unsaved draft), keyboard navigation intact; (b) no save path persists an untouched draft chat; (c) chats with no messages are excluded from the history-list feed (not deleted); (d) tests cover the opened menu's visible ordering/scroll intent and the no-empty-draft rule, including a check the fake DOM alone cannot satisfy.
body.summary: Opening a chat menu now shows its top and focuses the selected row without scrolling to it, so a fresh chat's history menu shows the most recent chats instead of the oldest empty ones. Changing model/effort or edit mode on a draft no longer saves it, and the history feed leaves out chats with no message (via a new ChatSessionStore.hasMessages). The real-browser check (history-menu-browser.live.test.ts) is gated on INSRC_LIVE_TESTS=1 like the repo's other browser tests, so the gate's run skips it; it was run by the builder with INSRC_LIVE_TESTS=1 and passed (pass 1, skipped 0; log /tmp/zzh/live-final.out), and it failed with the fix reverted (menu scrollTop 727, expected 0). Scope: this Story's change is exactly commit 6be43781d (8 files under vscode-plugin/src/chat). The other working-tree modifications (vscode-plugin/package.json insrc.review.maxJsonBytes, docs/vscode-plugin-screen-recording-script.html, .insrc/artifacts/BUILD-1bd72813bfa795f4-S001.json) were already uncommitted before this Story started (present in the session-start git status) and belong to other work in this shared tree; they are deliberately not part of this build.
